title: Welcome to SkyRPG
summary: What SkyRPG is, how to install the pack and join the server, and what is inside it.

s.x: SkyRPG is a Hypixel SkyBlock-style RPG for Minecraft Java Edition

, built on Fabric. You level skills, gather rare materials, craft better gear, fight bosses and clear dungeons, all the way up to the Ender Wyrm. Every gameplay system is our own mod. Other mods are only used for utilities.
This page tells you what you need to play, how to install it and join, and what the pack adds. Read

blocks.text: Good to know before you start

s.x: Your settings and HUD layout are saved on your own computer, not on the server.
Your purse, bank, skills, pets, collections and quest progress are saved with your character on the server.
The server keeps a log of chat, so do not post anything private there.
The Nether and the End are the vanilla dimensions, with new biomes, dungeons and bosses added.
